criteria.description: A Loom-routed deployment unit refuses dispatch when no worker policy is configured or selection produces an empty worker pubkey, without direct-runtime fallback or a Loom submission.

Before Loom publication, Bahia requires at least one normalized configured publish relay to overlap the freshly reloaded selected worker's advertised relays; unknown or disjoint relay sets refuse dispatch.
An admitted worker with relay overlap receives the Loom job; the run retains its worker, deployment unit, and real Loom job identity without direct-runtime fallback.
Non-Loom Docker and Compose units continue through direct runtime, and legacy workerless non-unit Loom dispatch remains outside the deployment-unit refusal rule.
